Add tenant-scoped account management (#38)

* feat: add tenant-scoped account management

Introduce multi-identifier identities and tenant-scoped administrator sessions without automatic account merging.

Backfill protected tenant administrator roles for existing tenants without promoting historical members.

* fix(ci): support fvm exec in check wrapper

generate-check resolves Dart with fvm exec, which the dynamic CI shim treated as a Flutter SDK binary.

* fix(ci): harden generated client check

Use a runner-provided search tool and ignore Melos IDE metadata already excluded by repository policy.

* fix(ci): clear Robin lint errors

* style(swan): apply pinned Dart formatting

* fix(ci): exclude generated Dart from format

Osprey and API generation checks own generated output; formatting it makes their canonical output stale.

* fix(ci): install Bubblewrap for DB tests

* fix(ci): enable Bubblewrap user namespaces

Ubuntu 24.04 AppArmor otherwise blocks loopback setup inside the isolated network namespace.
